name: mod-notification
description: Sends a notification (phone included, via ntfy) when Claude has finished or is waiting for your answer and you have not come back after a configurable delay. Uses no tokens.

delaySeconds.title: Delay before notifying (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: How long to wait without any reply from you before a notification is sent. 60 = 1 minute.

ntfyTopic.title: ntfy topic for phone pushes
ntfyTopic.description: Secret topic name you subscribe to in the ntfy app. Anyone who knows it can read your notifications, so pick a long random one. Empty = no phone push.

includePreview.title: Include the end of the answer in the notification
includePreview.description: When on, the last sentence of the answer (in the conversation language) is appended: usually Claude's question or the result. For a question dialog, the question itself.
